parameters.name: vb_type
parameters.description: Limits the stats to a specific virtual blockchain type.

parameters.description: Limits the stats to either genesis or non-genesis microblocks.

parameters.name: timestamp_gte
parameters.description: Minimum timestamp in milliseconds (inclusive). Resolution is 1 hour.

parameters.name: timestamp_lte
parameters.description: Maximum timestamp in milliseconds (inclusive). Resolution is 1 hour.
